node.label: Enlargement of the costochondral junction
node.definition: Abnormally increased size of the costochondral junctions, which are located between the distal part of the ribs and the costal cartilages, which are bars of hyaline cartilage that connect the ribs to the sternum.

evidence.snippet: Dyggve-Melchior-Clausen disease: Enlargement of the costochondral junction [TAS]
Spondylometaphyseal dysplasia, type A4: Enlargement of the costochondral junction [TAS]
